name: std::numeric_limits<T>::digits10
intro: The value of std::numeric_limits<T>::digits10 is the number of base-10 digits that can be represented by the type T without change, that is, any number with this many significant decimal digits can be converted to a value of type T and back to decimal form, without change due to rounding or overflow. For base-radix types, it is the value of digits() (digits - 1 for floating-point types) multiplied by \(\small \log_{10}{radix}\)log10(radix) and rounded down.
